flags.message: gemini-baseline labels a 3.9% baseline reached rate as prior-Term. The committed sal-v4 table assigns 3.9% to Term 2025, the prediction's own frozen Term; pooling displayed strictly prior Terms 2017-2024 instead yields 5.1202504% from rounded rates over weighted n=11,580. All evaluations use the correct risk-set pool. This is a rationale/anchor-selection error, not evidence of outcome leakage in a forward prediction. Details are in gemini-baseline's evaluation.md.
